scene: official Simple_Warehouse plus project A/B workcells

robot.model: official RB-Y1 A v1.2, floating base
robot.wheel_geometry_evidence: Pinned model USD wheel centers (0.228,+/-0.265,0.1), cylinder radius 0.1, joint axis Y with localRot0=(0,1,0,0) -> base -Y. Rolling sign is inferred from geometry and requires the physical drive probe.

tray.status: design; contact/support/envelope must be measured in Isaac

navigation.envelope_status: 0.6 is a design admission cap, NOT a transferred MuJoCo measurement. A fresh Isaac transport-pose collider envelope is required.
navigation.warehouse_status: Unknown until CollisionAPI bounds are extracted from the loaded warehouse stage; omission must reject navigation admission.
navigation.undock_and_dock: Separate straight reverse/forward yaw=0 motions; circle global-map clearance is not valid at the workcell dock. Caller must gate these with actual 3D geometry/contact/load checks.

limitations: No engine was run to validate this layout, wheel sign, loaded footprint, contact dynamics or route.
The route is a candidate; actual Nav2 output must be checked against the admitted static map.
The QP constrains local velocity commands and command slew, not actual acceleration, braking distance or global collision avoidance.
Static collider AABBs are conservative projected obstacles; source/destination docking needs separate 3D collision validation.
Ideal known coordinates and GT base pose are used. No LiDAR obstacle perception or dynamic obstacle velocity estimate is implemented here.
